summary:
Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, verified by reading only (no tests or repository code were run, and nothing was committed).

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union.
- rich/control.py: added the \x1b]0;{title}\x07 format entry and Control.title(title), which passes one (ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE, title) tuple.
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, guarded by is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring. No Windows calls.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: added one legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title) with the second item.
- CHANGELOG.md: added an Unreleased "Added" section with one bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only, mocked wrapper).

Choices: the non-legacy render path needed no change because the title segment's text is already the escape sequence with no style. The console test skip uses sys.platform == "win32". The "Added" heading was created because Unreleased had none.
